about: Blank Foundation Knowledge Base template. Fill in entries and import them in Settings → Foundation Knowledge Base (or with python -m backend.scripts.load_foundation_profile FILE). Keep the filled-in file out of git.

mission_history.label: Mission and history
mission_history.hint: Who the foundation is, why it exists, and how its story should be told. Only what the board confirms.

signature_events.label: Signature events
signature_events.hint: The foundation's recurring events (for example a gala or a community fundraiser): what they are, who comes, what they cost and raise, and what to keep or change.

past_fundraisers.label: Past fundraisers
past_fundraisers.hint: One occurrence of an event (for example the 2025 gala). Link it to its Our Legacy record so figures stay in one place.

vendors_venues.label: Vendors and venues
vendors_venues.hint: Venues, caterers, entertainment, planners, studios, printers, photographers, sponsors, and community partners the foundation has used. Mark a vendor as used only when an event record or a board member confirms it.

relationships.label: Charitable relationships
relationships.hint: Organizations the foundation has worked with or featured. Keep historical collaboration separate from a formal, ongoing partnership.

fields.activities: Events or activities connected to it

community_audience.label: Community and audience
community_audience.hint: Hometown roots, who usually comes to events, networks, volunteers, supporters, and prospective sponsors. No statistics or assumptions about anyone's health.

board.label: Board structure
board.hint: Board members, roles, committees, and what each would like to review. Contact details are shown only to the chair.

fundraising_priorities.label: Fundraising priorities
fundraising_priorities.hint: Goals for the year, what the board wants events to achieve, and campaigns.

financial_guidelines.label: Financial guidelines
financial_guidelines.hint: Board-approved budgets, typical event cost ranges, reserve and restricted-fund rules. Say which kind of figure each is.

communication.label: Communication preferences
communication.hint: How the foundation introduces itself, tone, and what to include or avoid in letters and outreach.
